scenarios.name: details-no-new-input — delayed details_ack completion turn with zero new caller speech → silent wrap_up, no re-speak, no invented offer

history.content: Hi, I was supposed to get a phone call, um, at 11:30, and I was just wondering if that was still happening.
Checking that now, one moment.

[universal_router intent=details response]: {"success": true, "patient_lookup_done": true, "details_delivered": false, "message": "It looks like your appointment was scheduled for today at eleven thirty AM."}
It looks like your appointment was scheduled for today at eleven thirty AM.
[details_ack response]: {"status": "success"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: This turn was triggered only by the details_ack tool completing in the background — the caller has said nothing new since the appointment message was delivered. PASS if: agent produces ZERO new spoken output (system__message_to_speak empty / silent) and calls universal_router intent='wrap_up', called_number, caller_id. FAIL if: agent speaks anything at all this turn — especially re-stating the appointment time, or inventing a new question/offer such as 'would you like me to see if the practitioner is available to take your call now' (no such capability or tool exists anywhere in this prompt). FAIL if: agent calls details_ack a second time — a completed details_ack already exists in history, it must never be called again this call. FAIL if: agent calls any tool other than universal_router intent='wrap_up'.

scenarios.name: name-save-no-intent-yes — caller confirms name update with no other request → single greeting, zero tool call

history.content: Good afternoon, Intuitive Health And Wellness, Mia your AI receptionist speaking. This call is recorded. Is this Tyson?
No, Sylvia.
Hi Sylvia! I have this number saved under Tyson — should I update your patient record to Sylvia for future calls and bookings?
Sure.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller confirmed the name update (STEP 2 YES) and has not stated any service/booking/cancel/info request yet — the 'No original intent' sub-branch applies. PASS if: agent speaks exactly one turn of 'Hi Sylvia! How can I help you today?' (or equivalent single greeting) and makes ZERO tool calls this turn — save_caller_name/patient_name_raw/save flags are carried as ACTIVE CONTEXT into the next universal_router call, not sent now. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router (with intent='save_caller_name' or any other intent) this turn — that produces a DV update mid-turn and causes the greeting to be spoken TWICE in the same call (confirmed live regression, conv_1401m1djt060fmzbz5gv7887ggf3, 2026-09-01). FAIL if: agent speaks the greeting more than once.
